title: amelanchier alnifolia subsp. subintegra
intro: Amelanchier alnifolia subsp. subintegra, commonly known as Dwarf Saskatoon, is a deciduous shrub species native to Western Canada. This plant is valued for its edible berries, which are rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as potential protection against cardiovascular disease and certain cancers. The therapeutic actions of Amelanchier alnifolia subsp. subintegra berries include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may contribute to its potential uses in traditional medicine for wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may have synergistic effects when combined with other herbal remedies.
